title: HDFC Multi Cap Fund - Monthly Scheme Factsheet

sections.content: HDFC Multi Cap Fund is an open-ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks. As of October 2026, total Scheme AUM is ₹19,490.01 Crore. Direct Plan Growth NAV is ₹18.176. Fund Manager: Gopal Agrawal (Senior Vice President, managing since December 2021).

Total Expense Ratio (TER) for Direct Plan is 0.96% per annum. Exit load: 1.00% if redeemed or switched out within 1 year from the date of allotment. Nil exit load after 365 days from unit allotment date.

Benchmark: NIFTY 500 Multicap 50:25:25 Total Return Index (TRI). Portfolio allocation across market caps: Large Cap 42.10%, Mid Cap 27.40%, Small Cap 26.80%, Cash & Equivalents 3.70%. Riskometer: Very High Risk.
